target_roles.title: VP of Product Management
target_roles.rationale: As a manufacturer of large-format printing systems targeting outdoor signage, vehicle wraps, and architectural graphics, Durst's product leadership owns the complete value proposition delivered to their customers. This role is responsible for ensuring Durst's printers enable end-users to produce durable, long-lasting output that matches Durst's brand promise of 'performance, reliability, and longevity.' By integrating Tedlar as a recommended or certified overlaminate solution, Product Management can differentiate Durst's P5 series and other platforms with a proven 12-20+ year outdoor durability story, directly addressing customer pain points around UV degradation, fading, and premature failure. This role cares deeply about competitive positioning in the premium segment, customer success metrics, warranty claim reduction, and creating ecosystem partnerships that enhance Durst's total solution value. With recent launches like the P5 X and P5 SMP, they're actively seeking ways to strengthen their outdoor application story and protect their reputation for quality—making Tedlar a strategic product ecosystem opportunity that drives differentiation, reduces support costs, and enables premium pricing.

target_roles.title: Director of Business Development
target_roles.rationale: Durst's active presence at PRINTING United, ISA Expo, and Labelexpo demonstrates aggressive market expansion and customer acquisition efforts. Business Development owns revenue growth, market penetration, and strategic partnerships that expand Durst's addressable market and competitive advantage. Tedlar represents a compelling partner solution that allows Durst to offer a complete outdoor durability story to sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics producers—addressing a critical downstream need that affects customer satisfaction and repeat business. This role is measured on pipeline growth, partnership revenue, win rates against competitors, and market share expansion. By establishing Tedlar as a certified or recommended protective film partner, they can create joint go-to-market initiatives, co-selling opportunities, and bundled solutions that position Durst as the premium choice for outdoor applications. Given Durst's emphasis on outdoor signage, billboards, and vehicle graphics—all markets where substrate protection directly impacts end-user satisfaction—this role would immediately see the value in a partnership that reduces customer complaints, extends product lifespan, and creates a differentiated selling proposition that drives both equipment sales and recurring consumables revenue.

target_roles.title: Director of Customer Success
target_roles.rationale: For a global technology company with 1,100+ employees serving customers in 40+ countries, customer retention, satisfaction scores, and post-sale support efficiency are critical KPIs. This role owns the customer experience after equipment purchase, including addressing performance issues, warranty claims, technical support escalations, and ensuring customers achieve their ROI. Durst's customers in outdoor signage and vehicle wraps frequently face challenges with premature fading, UV damage, and graphics degradation—issues that generate support tickets, erode customer satisfaction, and damage Durst's reputation for reliability. By recommending Tedlar as a best-practice protective solution, Customer Success can proactively reduce complaint volume, lower warranty claim rates, and position Durst as a trusted advisor who helps customers maximize their equipment investment. This role cares about NPS scores, support ticket reduction, customer churn prevention, and demonstrating measurable value to existing accounts. Tedlar's 12-20+ year durability, UV protection, and graffiti resistance directly address the most common pain points their customers face in outdoor applications, making it a tool to improve customer outcomes, reduce support costs, and increase account retention—all while strengthening Durst's consultative positioning in the market.
